# Elmar Kenigs

> Online resume for Elmar Kenigs, Lead Software Engineer (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, AWS, Web3). Founding engineer at Sudory; previously led the Tanssi, Moonbeam, and DataHaven dApp teams at OpsLayer.

The site is a single page. The HTML page is the source of truth for biographical and professional details.

## Pages

- [Resume](https://kenigs.dev/): summary, experience, selected work, skills, education, languages, interests
